helpPanel.title: ❓ How does it work?
helpPanel.addActivityQ: How do I add an activity?
helpPanel.addActivityA: Tap a child card on Home → pick a day → tap "+" to add an activity from your library. You can also create your own activities in Library.
helpPanel.dragQ: Can I drag and move activities?
helpPanel.dragA: Yes! In the child's schedule view (tap a card on Home) you can press and drag activities to change order. You can also drag an activity onto another day tab to copy it.
helpPanel.copyQ: How do I copy the schedule to every day?
helpPanel.copyA: In the schedule editor (📋 button) → choose "Copy to other days" to copy one day's schedule to the rest of the week.
helpPanel.earnStarsQ: How does my child earn stars?
helpPanel.earnStarsA: Each completed activity gives 1 star. Your child checks off in child view. You can also give bonus stars from the child card on Home.
helpPanel.treasureQ: How does the Treasure Chest work?
helpPanel.treasureA: In child view, tap the ⭐ icon to see the Treasure Chest — a list of rewards and how many stars they cost. Your child can request a reward when they have saved enough.
helpPanel.retroQ: How do I fill in stars for days I forgot?
helpPanel.retroA: Go to Today (☰ menu → Today, or the Log later button on Home). Pick the child, browse to the right day with the arrows or date picker, and check off the activities. Stars are saved with the correct date.
helpPanel.rewardsQ: How do I add or edit rewards?
helpPanel.rewardsA: Go to Library in the menu → the "Rewards" tab. There you can add your own rewards, edit star cost, and choose which children see them.
helpPanel.siblingQ: How do I add a sibling?
helpPanel.siblingA: On Home → tap "+ Add child". Each child gets their own schedule, activities, and stars.
helpPanel.childLoginQ: How does my child log in?
helpPanel.childLoginA: For the first few days you can preview the child's day via Today. When you are ready, your child logs in at /child-login with username and PIN — no passwords. You will find the details under Family & settings → Children.
helpPanel.inviteAdultQ: How do I invite another adult?
helpPanel.inviteAdultA: Go to Family & settings → Family members → tap "Invite". They get an email with a link to create their own account and join the family.
helpPanel.inviteSeeQ: Can the invited adult see every child?
helpPanel.inviteSeeA: You choose which children they can see when you send the invite. You can change that later under Family members → tap the person → adjust child access.
helpPanel.noActivitiesQ: My child sees no activities today
helpPanel.noActivitiesA: Check that the schedule is set for the right day. Open the child's schedule (tap the child card) → pick today → see if there are activities. If the schedule is empty: use "Copy to other days" to fill it.
helpPanel.forgotPinQ: I have forgotten the child's PIN
helpPanel.forgotPinA: Go to Family & settings → Children → pick the child → tap "Change PIN" to set a new PIN.
